title: Expediter: Delivery tracking
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Which of our open orders have delivery problems I need to chase today?

answer.question: Which of our open orders have delivery problems I need to chase today?
answer.answer:
Two orders need chasing today:

1. **PO-88017, Corran Cables (11 kV cable drums, 6 × 500 m).** The ASN shows 4 of 6 drums arriving 3 Nov 2026, but the last 2 are due 12 Nov, 9 days late. The Feeder 7 Harbour Street section starts in 10 days and needs all 6 drums on site, so this is the most urgent. Contact Corran Cables and tell the project team to re-plan.

2. **PO-88044, Ardmore Switchgear (11 kV switchboard panels, 8 units).** Not acknowledged 5 days after issue. The committed date of 8 Jan 2027 is unconfirmed. I can draft a reminder asking for acknowledgement and date confirmation.

PO-88031 (Ferris Line Fittings) is on track for 10 Nov.

I haven't contacted anyone or changed any orders. The buyer or expediter would send the supplier messages.
